metadata.name: risk-escalate
metadata.description: Flag blocked or slipping items to the team lead with full cross-tool context. LOCKED at L3 (always-approval at L3; autonomous send only at L4 with operator opt-in).
metadata.unlock_requirement: Promote worker to L3; outbound send still approval-gated at L3.

kind.template: Compute slippage_days vs milestone_calendar; cross-reference linear-read.blocked_by_ids and github-read.review_state. Trigger when slippage_days >= worker.policy.escalation_threshold_days.
Bundle: affected milestone, owner, blocker chain (linear + github), recommended next steps, tone-matched Slack draft, confidence.

kind.instruction: Post the approved escalation packet to the configured project-lead Slack channel; log to communication_log.
